name: Torres de Berrellén (Spain)
description: Blue field with a chequered yellow and black hoist part with a semicircular edge, charged with a yellow fleur-de-lis.
history: Municipal flag of Torres de Berrellén; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chequy of yellow and black at the hoist with a semicircular fly edge
fleur-de-lis on the blue beside the chequy
